reason: PR #24 review, observation 1: acquire10.execute checked owner authorization and space but did not itself enforce a fresh hostmem10 GO for the download profile; dry_run.would_proceed_if_authorized considered storage only.

PR #24 review, observation 2: the CI workflow did not verify the identity of the executed tests against the M10 inventory; 11 increment-9 tests cannot run on the runner (local unsanitized originals absent) and must be reported as not verifiable, never PASS, with a separate local attestation.
hostmem10 reports did not identify their baseline file; the acquisition gate needs the baseline SHA256 and UTC time to reject stale or swapped baselines.

invariants.note: every frozen section is still rebuilt from code and compared byte-for-byte by protocol10 check

acquisition_host_gate.rule: acquire10 --execute refuses before any network request, and again under the lock before the first payload request, unless tools/hostgate10.py returns GO: protocol10 check passes; the report names the pinned protocol SHA256, profile download, the preregistered 30 s interval and the SHA256 of the supplied baseline; both Windows samples are present; every quantity and the verdict are recomputed from the raw snapshots with the frozen download criteria; the report is at most 900 s old and not in the future; the baseline precedes it and is at most 12 h old; checkpoint and backing paths and volume sizes match the acquisition. Owner authorization is a separate record and is never implied by GO (nor GO by authorization).

not_verifiable_on_runner.skip_message: local unsanitized originals are not on this machine
not_verifiable_on_runner.cause: tests/test_increment9_hardening.py "-real" cases need the local unsanitized M9 originals, which are deliberately not in Git (sanitization of increment 9)

ci_runner_verification.rule: runner verdict PASS = every runner-verifiable required test passed, nothing missing, extra or duplicated, and each declared test either passed or was skipped with exactly the declared message; such a skip is NOT VERIFIABLE ON RUNNER and keeps the full-inventory verdict of the runner at NOT PROVEN. The archived local attestation must be a full PASS of the same inventory with its pinned JUnit SHA256. CI succeeds only if both hold.
